translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: LUCAS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni LUCAS

content: Dos Puhawang to Kod‑imatoy ki Disas
Na, asow ron od inguma iddos pista to Paan no Waa Potuvu no id ngoranan mandad no pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.
Dos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises, id nangkap dan to po‑ukit to kod‑imatoy ki Disas no waa od pokosaddoo, oyyos od kovaakkan dan to mgo minuvu.
Na, id losuran ni Moivuyan si Judas no id ngoranan ki Iscariote no sokkad taddot sopuu‑oruwon apostoles.
Mid undiyon sikandin to mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy riyot mgo ponguu to tohodtamong to templo amoy od pomuhawang to kodboligya ki Disas diyot kandan.
Oraroy ran no nahaa taddon puhawang woy id totandu ran nod boggoy to soopi riyot ki Judas.
De‑en id aman si Judas, woy id nangkap sikandin to ollog no timpu to kodboligya ki Disas no dii od pokosaddoo iddos mo‑uraan minuvu.
Id Ka‑an si Disas to Kotompusan no Kodlavung Duma to mgo Tinodduwan Din
Na, id inguma ron iddos unnon allow to pista to Paan no Waa Potuvu. Idda en no allow, ko‑ilangan nod buwis to natin karnero iddos mgo Judio atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.
De‑en id pomonduwan ni Disas si Pedro woy si Juan. Kahi rin to, “Unna kowd bo woy panoy kow to lavung ta atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.”
Mid intud sikandan to, “Longaggon, ingkon man kos id kopi‑i ru no id panoy roy idda?”
Kahin Disas to, “Otid inguma kow riyot bonuwa to Jerusalem, duwon mama nod kosinuggung dow no id tiyang to gunsu no duwon oweg. Tundug kow vo kandin diyot baoy nod undiyonnan din.
Osengi row iddos komunoy taddot baoy no, ‘Id intud iddos Tohodnonaw ko ingkon kos kwartu no od kannan din to kodlavung atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan duma to mgo tinodduwan din.’
Na, id pokita rin koniyu iddos mowwag no kwartu riyot iko‑oruwon ondana no nopanoy ron tapoy iddos langun nod ko‑ilonganon ta. Ponaya row rutun iddos lavung ta.”
Purisu id ipanow onsi Pedro, woy nokita ran iddos langun nid ikahi ni Disas kandan woy id panoy ran iddos lavung atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan.
To id inguma ron iddos uras to kodlavung, mid unsad si Disas duma taddot mgo apostoles amoy'd ka‑an.
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Id kopi‑i ku nod pokodduma ki nod lavung atag to pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan to dii a pa od ukit to kodposuppit.
Su od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no dii ad od ka‑an ka‑ay'n koka‑an taman to od kotuman don iddos bonnaan kohulugan ka‑ay riyot timpu nod hari ron kos Monama.”
Na mid angoy sikandin to kupa woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id ikohiyan din sikandan to, “Owata row ini woy inom kow langun ka‑ay.
Oyyos od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no dii ad od inom to ammis to ubas taman tod inguma ron iddos timpu no od hari ron kos Monama.”

Na, mid angoy sikandin to paan woy id posolamat sikandin diyot Monama. Nopongnga, id toppiktoppik din idda woy id toyyow riyot kandan, kahi rin to, “Ini en kos lawa ku no id buwis atag koniyu. Puungi row ini to kodsampot koddi.”
To nokoka‑an don sikandan, mid angoy mandad sikandin to kupa woy kahi rin to, “Ini en kos patow to lammin kodpotonduwoy to Monama koniyu no od posivonnalan ukit to longossa ku nod tihis atag koniyu.
“Piru od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no duma ta rad en ka‑ay no mid ka‑an iddos minuvu nod boligya koddi.
Oyyos siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od patoy en iling taddot tapoy'n puhawang to Monama. Piru moka‑arat‑arat kod kotomanan taddot minuvu nod boligya koddi.”
To norinog dan idda, id po‑inturoy ran ko ondoy kandan kos od puung to ungketen.
Dos Kodpo‑opuloy to mgo Tinodduwan ni Disas ko Ondoy Kandan kos od Kilaannan no Mowwet
Na, id po‑opuloy iddos mgo tinodduwan ni Disas ko ondoy kandan kos od kilaannon no mowwet.
De‑en kahin Disas kandan to, “Ka‑ay to ampow't ingod, id pomohos taddot mgo hari iddos id kopi‑i ran nod puungan to mgo sakup dan, woy id kopi‑i ran mandad nod kilaannon no motavangtavang.
Piru sikiyu, konna kow iling kandan. Su iddos od kilaannon no mowwet koniyu, ko‑ilangan nod poobbava woy dos ponguu, ko‑ilangan no iling to sudsuhuwon kos botasan din.
Na, ondoy man kos od kilaannon no mowwet? Idda vo so id sondaran to koka‑an o iddos id sondad? Idda en so id sondaran. Piru siyak nod Longaggon dow, noko‑iling a to sudsuhuwon dow.
“Sikiyu en kos id duma koddi ahad diyot langun no kosupittan no no‑ukitan ku.
Na, su id boggayan a man to Amoy ku to kotungud nod hari, ungketen dad en mandad kos od puungan ku koniyu.
Od pokoruma kow koddi nod ka‑an init kodhari ku, woy od po‑unsaron ku sikiyu riyot trunu amoy od hukum to sopuu‑oruwon tribu to koubbaran ni Israel.”
Id Ponudtuu Tapoy ni Disas iddos Kod‑elle ni Pedro Kandin

Na kahin Disas ki Simon Pedro to, “Simon, bantoy ka. Id aman kos Monama ki Moivuyan no od geddaman kow. Dos kodgeddam din koniyu, noko‑iling to kodloyyak to ommoy amoy'd pod‑ossan iddos oppes woy tiparay, su saddook iling to oppes kos kopomakoy row.
Piru id dasaa ad atag kikow amoy diid kotalu kos kopomakoy ru. Od inoyyug ka en koddi, piru kod livod ka, inniyatow kos mgo suwod du riyot kopomakoy.”
Mid tavak si Pedro to, “Longaggon, nopanoy a en nod duma kikow ahad pa riyot prisuwan woy riyot kopotayan.”
Piru kahin Disas to, “Od ikohiyan ku sikkow, Pedro, no to dii pa od ukkaa kos manuk ko‑ungkay'n bulli, ko‑otollu rud tod elle no waa ka id kilaa koddi.”
Dos Asow ron od Ingumon Kosupittan

Na kahin Disas diyot mgo tinodduwan din to, “Iddot id suhu ku sikiyu amoy'd ponudtuu to kahit Monama no waa ku sikiyu popiyodda to soopi, kavii o sandalyas, ondan, nokulangan kow vo?” Mid tavak sikandan to, “Wora en.”
Kahin Disas to, “Piru ko‑ungkay, ko‑ilangan no od piyod kowd to kavii woy soopi. Iddos ahad ondoy no waa polihuma, ko‑ilangan no id boligya rin kos umpak din amoy'd pokovolli sikandin tadda.
Oyyos ko‑ilangan en nod kotuman iddos no‑ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama moka‑atag koddi no mid ungketen to,
Na, asow ron ini od kotuman.”
Kahi ran to, “Longaggon, ontongngiyu, duwon oruwon polihuma ka‑ay.” Kahin Disas to, “Ollog don.”
Dos Koddasaa ni Disas diyot Buvungan to mgo Olibo
Na mid tanan si Disas pomon dutun, woy id undiyon sikandin to Buvungan to mgo Olibo, su idda me‑en kos nooyami rin nod puungan. Id duma kandin iddos mgo tinodduwan din.
To id inguma ron sikandan dutun, mid ikahi sikandin to, “Dasaa kow amoy dii kow od kopiyod diyot kodpuung to saa.”
Na, id poriyu boyow sikandin woy rutun, mid lingko‑od sikandin amoy'd dasaa.
Kahi rin to, “Amoy ku, otid aman ka, yo ad po‑ukita tod ingumon koosayan. Piru konna inis id kopi‑i ku kos od kotuman, ko konna, idda rad en so kikow'n id kopi‑i.”
[Na, duwon ponolihan pomon diyot datas to langit no mid porani amoy'd ponokkaa kandin.
Pomon to oraroy sikandin id lanu, id monit pe‑en kos koddasaa rin no golid taddu kos ating din diyot livuta iling to longossa.]
To nopongnga sikandin mid dasaa, id livod sikandin diyot mgo tinodduwan din, woy nokita rin sikandan no nokotinuhon pomon tid moomet dan to mattag lanu.
Kahin Disas kandan to, “Mambot id tinuhon kow moho? Onnow kowd woy dasaa kow amoy dii kow od kopiyod diyot kodpuung to saa.”
Dos Kod‑ammot ki Disas

Laggun tod ooseng pa si Disas, id inguma iddos mo‑uraan minuvu. Iyon id ponguu kandan, si Judas no sokkad taddot sopuu‑oruwon tinodduwan din. Id porani sikandin ki Disas amoy'd pongumusta ukit to kod‑arok.
Piru mid ikahi si Disas to, “Judas, ukit bos to kod‑arok kos kodboligya koddi no Anak to Minuvu?”
To nokita taddot mgo tinodduwan ni Disas no od omotton sikandin, mid ikahi sikandan to, “Longaggon, od ponibbason doyd bo sikandan?”
Na, id tibbas to sokkad taddot mgo tinodduwan din iddos uripon to mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis, de-en no-utas kos kowanan no tolinga rin.
Piru mid ikahi si Disas to, “Ollog don duwon!” Na, id somaddan ni Disas iddos tolinga taddon uripon woy idda ra en, no‑uliyan don sikandin.

Iddos mid undiyon amoy'd ammot ki Disas, idda en so mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, dos mgo ponguu to tohodtamong to templo woy dos duma pon od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio. Kahin Disas kandan to, “Kriminal a vo su goli kow'd piyod to mgo polihuma woy mgo badas to kod‑ammot koddi?
Allow‑allow a man id nonaw riyot templo, piru waa a man nikiyu omotta. Piru ini ron en kos koniyun timpu woy timpu ni Moivuyan nod hari riyot mosukirom.”
Dos Kod‑elle ni Pedro ki Disas
Na, id ammot dan si Disas woy id piyod diyot baoy to mowwet no ponguu to mgo tohodbuwis. Si Pedro, id tintinundug no moriyu boyow.
Diyot tongannan to lama, id totavun iddos mgo minuvu woy id ounsad amoy'd oinarang. Id porani mandad si Pedro amoy'd oinarang duma kandan.
Na rutun, duwon sokkad no ba‑ay no sudsuhuwon no nokokita ki Pedro no notorawwan to apuy. De‑en id totongtong sikandin woy mid ikahi to, “Inin minuvu, duma en sikandin duwot id ammot.”
Piru mid elle si Pedro, kahi rin to, “Te, Idi, waa a moho nokokilaa kandin.”

Waa nouhoy pomon tadda, duwon mandad sokkad no mama no nokokita ki Pedro woy mid ikahi to, “Ee, sikkow me‑en moho iddos sokkad taddot mgo duma rin.” Piru mid tavak si Pedro to, “Te, aawang ka ron od ooseng! Konna ku moho sikandin duma.”
To mgo sokkad don no uras kos id lihad, duwon don mandon mid ikahi to, “Bonnaa en no inin minuvu, duma en sikandin duwot na‑ammot, su toho Galilea man mandad sikandin.”
Piru mid tavak si Pedro to, “Te, waa ron en moho sinorollan ku ruwot id oseng du.” Laggun tod ooseng pa si Pedro, idda ron en, id ukkaa kos manuk.

Na, id loingoy dos od Longaggon woy id totongtong ki Pedro. Idda ron en, nosompottan din iddos id ikahi ni Disas no, “To dii pa od ukkaa kos manuk ko‑ungkay'n bulli, ko‑otollu rud tod elle no waa ka id kilaa koddi.”
Id leggua si Pedro woy oray'n mopet kos sinoggawon din.
Dos Kodsumpalit ki Disas
Na, id sumpalit si Disas woy id ponlompossan sikandin taddot mgo minuvu nid tamong kandin.
Id sobpongngan dan kos mata rin, woy id ikohiyan to, “Otik mooggot ka no propeta, otukow ve‑en ko ondoy kos id tabpi kikow!”
Na, mo‑uraa pa kos id sumpalit dan kandin.
Dos Kod‑isau ni Disas diyot Hukumanan to mgo Judio
To od ka‑allow ron, id lolivuung iddos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio. Dos duma kandan, mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises. Id angoy ran si Disas amoy id po‑isau kandan.
Kahi ran ki Disas to, “Ponudtuli koy, sikkow ve‑en kos Mesiyas?” Mid tavak si Disas to, “Ahad od ponudtulan ku sikiyu, dii kow man od pongimbonnaa.
Woy otid boliyungan ku sikiyu tod intud, dii kow man od tavak.
Piru pomon ko‑ungkay, siyak no Anak to Minuvu, od unsad diyon lomig to kowanan to Monamon Motuus.”
Na langun dan, mid intud kandin, kahi rin to, “Ko ungketen, sikkow vo kos Anak to Monama?” Kahin Disas to, “No‑oseng dowd en.”
De‑en mid ikahi sikandan to, “Konnad ko‑ilangan nod angoy ki pa to duma amoy'd posivonnaa taddot saa rin, oyyos siketa ron en kos nokorinog taddot id oseng din.”
